subject.title: fix(browser): stop screenshot vision-failure fallback from injecting raw base64

question: Should a configured image-understanding failure intentionally suppress the existing raw screenshot fallback, even when the primary model might otherwise consume that image directly?
rationale: The patch fixes session contamination by changing a user-visible recovery behavior; source and tests establish the tradeoff, but they cannot determine whether preserving screenshot availability or preventing all image persistence is the intended product contract.

options.title: Adopt text-only failure semantics
options.body: Confirm that a configured vision-model failure must return only the failure notice and explicit share path, then require handler-level end-to-end proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve image recovery
options.body: Keep the raw-image fallback for configured vision failures and address contamination at the session-history or result-storage boundary instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt text-only failure semantics
recommendation.body: Confirm that a configured vision-model failure must return only the failure notice and explicit share path, then require handler-level end-to-end proof before merge.
